features.name: IV-RV premium signal
features.what: The board's options leg: the z-score of credit-ETF ATM implied vol vs realized vol, accrued daily from real listed options chains (IV floor gate 0.02 keeps degraded feeds out).
features.note: Accruing real daily snapshots (weekday 18:00 launchd). Per ticker: HYG 4/20 · LQD 4/20 · TLT 4/20 · EMB 4/20 · ANGL 2/20 · JNK 2/20.
features.dateNote: Weekday estimate from the last real snapshot; a degraded-feed day (IV gate) adds a day. The leg unlocks itself the day the 20th real snapshot lands.

features.name: COT BBG HY credit futures leg
features.what: Net leveraged-money / dealer positioning on the Bloomberg HY credit futures contract — listed 2026-03.
features.note: The ≥2-year history gate (COT_MIN_HISTORY_YEARS) needs weekly reports from the contract's 2026-03 listing. The board reports this honestly; no code change can accelerate real history.
features.dateNote: This card flips to live on its own the first day the 2-year history window is complete.

features.name: Per-country straddle yield / VRP
features.what: Spec §3.3-3.4 country legs: ATM straddle yield and vol-risk premium outside the US.
features.note: No free per-country ETF options chain exists in the daily accrual yet. This card flips to live automatically the first day a real country chain accrues (checked daily by the launchd daemon).
features.dateNote: No date can be promised — the exchanges' chains are the gate, and thin markets decide.

features.name: EMHY options chain
features.what: ATM implied vol + straddle for the EM high-yield ETF (iShares EMHY).
features.note: EMHY has no listed expiries on the free feed — a genuine thin-market fact. This card flips to live automatically the first day a real chain exists.
features.dateNote: No date can be promised — the exchange lists expiries on its own schedule.

features.name: ANGL ATM straddle quote
features.what: Real ATM straddle price for the fallen-angel ETF (ANGL) — the thin chain has no straddle quote yet.
features.note: ANGL accrues IV (2/20) but its thin chain carries no ATM straddle quote. This card flips to live automatically the first day a real straddle snapshot accrues.
features.dateNote: No date can be promised — the quote appears when the market makes it.
